Brands]].{{Cite web |last=Jaiswar |first=Pooja Sitaram |date=2022-11-23 |title=This smallcap stock hits fresh 52-week high. Should you buy more? |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/this-smallcap-stock-hits-fresh-52-week-high-should-you-buy-more-11669192997230.html |access-date=2023-12-20 |website=mint |language=en}} In 2006, Goldman Sachs invested in the company but sold its stake in 2010 to a private equity firm.{{Cite news |last=Balakrishnan |first=Reghu |date=2023-09-12 |title=Mrs. Bector's Food to sell its biscuit business |work=Business Standard |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/mrs-bector-s-food-to-sell-its-biscuit-business-113091100747_1.html}} The company was listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] in December 2020. == Tax investigation == On October 17, 2023, the [[Income Tax Department]] searched the company's offices. Documents were seized and bank lockers and accounts searched. The company denied wrongdoing.{{Cite news |date=2023-10-22 |title=I-T raid on city's leading business groups ends |work=The Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/ludhiana/i-t-raid-on-citys-leading-business-groups-ends/articleshow/104618766.cms |access-date=2023-12-18 |issn=0971-8257}}{{Cite news |date=October 18, 2023 |title=I-T raids continue on Trident, Bectors Food groups in Ludhiana |url=https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/ludhiana/i-t-raids-continue-on-trident-bectors-food-groups-in-ludhiana-554557 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231019103601/https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/ludhiana/i-t-raids-continue-on-trident-bectors-food-groups-in-ludhiana-554557 |archive-date=October 19, 2023 |work=The Tribune}} == References == [[Category:Food and drink companies of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1977]]
